value_updates.row_extension_workflow: Insert a row, copy the fields into the new row, and then enter the new content.

patches.decision_note: The accepted insert-row workflow replaces the earlier expectation that users extend the structure by adding a line directly after Topic.
The robust editable-field approach may replace the obligation to fix the password-dependent legacy controls, but the client does not clearly state whether legacy_field_handling remains required.
The one-hour due-diligence outputs may replace assessment_outputs, but they may instead be an additional preliminary phase before the previously requested proposal outputs.
